video_title: Shumpert - "Wemby Is ALREADY The Face Of The NBA!

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert declares Victor Wembanyama the face of the NBA
quotes.excerpt: He already the face. He face.
quotes.quote: He already the face. He face.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Victor Wembanyama's commitment to the game
quotes.excerpt: I just know that if anybody is going to take the challenge, he takes the challenge.
quotes.quote: I just know that if anybody is going to take the challenge, he takes the challenge. He checks off the boxes. He is going to have to win his rings to solidify it, but even if he doesn't win the ring, the NBA is going to make money off this dude because none go see him play.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Victor Wembanyama's impact on the game
quotes.excerpt: He influences the games in places that stats just aren't going to matter.
quotes.quote: For what he means to his team and what he is going to mean to this league, yes. Do I think that there aren't going to be players that at times we are going to say or they are going to be having a run that we would be like, is he the best? Yes, to tell you the truth, yes. Because he is 7'5", he influences the games in places that stats just aren't going to matter. Changing shots in a way we have never seen it done.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert predicts a future dynasty for the San Antonio Spurs
quotes.excerpt: I think that we will see the dynasty out of the Spurs first.
quotes.quote: I think that we will see the dynasty out of the Spurs first, granted with injuries, because the Spurs are in this position because they didn't have Dejounte Murray, they didn't have AJ Mitchell, so they lost ball handlers. They got over the line because injuries is a part of the game. But granted, on the other side of it, if injuries don't affect the Spurs in a huge way, I think that it is obvious the Spurs will be the quicker to the dynasty.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Chet Holmgren's need to play more aggressively
quotes.excerpt: If you just take this personal, you will have a better showing.
quotes.quote: I don't think it is a scared thing. I think it is he wants to play the politically correct game and we don't care. If you just take this personal, you will have a better showing. Just take it personal. I don't like him, he don't like me. I beat him back then, they don't beat us this time. When I see him next year, it is on. It is going to have to be personal because I think he is letting the game go because he is trying not to make it personal.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the future of the Oklahoma City Thunder
quotes.excerpt: I think that if I am Oklahoma City, I am more challenging Chet.
quotes.quote: I think that if I am Oklahoma City, I am more challenging Chet. It would be one thing if Chet went two for 20 every game and we got to see like maybe he just doesn't have it or this guy is blocking his shot every time. Nobody is really blocking his shot or keeping him from doing anything. It is just he hasn't really unlocked a mindset that matches the Western Conference Finals this year.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the difficulty of winning with a small best player
quotes.excerpt: We haven't seen it win. I mean outside of an Isaiah Thomas championship.
quotes.quote: I have agreed with it because I think naturally as we have been fans of basketball, we haven't seen it win. I mean outside of an Isaiah Thomas championship, we are not really looking at the little guys being able to get it done because at the end of games when that is your best player or your best offensive option, them being able to score over a double team at their height just becomes difficult when they put a larger defender on you or they throw a trap at you.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the upcoming matchup between Karl-Anthony Towns and Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: It is going to be interesting to see how early Karl-Anthony Towns can get into a cat and mouse.
quotes.quote: With the way they are running things through Karl-Anthony Towns right now, it is going to be interesting because if Victor Wembanyama takes that matchup, which I am not sure what they will do. They always seem to game one or game two people like to do funky stuff to throw the other team off. So I can expect him to roam on anybody. But if he does take the Karl-Anthony Towns matchup, Karl-Anthony Towns has gotten good at showing something or shooting the ball with no hesitation to then being able to do that quick show to the rip and drive.
